examples.text: Je ne suis pas actrice. Je veux juste voir Mathias.

meanings.note: Un appel de Rio = a call from Rio. Masculine noun ('le appel', plural 'les appels') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'call'.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = can I call you?

examples.text: Appelle Clémentine. Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir ce soir.
examples.trans: Call Clémentine. Tell her I can't come tonight.

meanings.note: Neutral, polite. Spoken French phrase expression meaning 'goodbye', common in natural conversation.
